parsed.rationale: A newly invited analyst receives an 'access denied' message after accepting the invite, while other users can log in normally. This is an account/workspace access issue requiring human troubleshooting.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for the details. I’m sorry your new analyst is being blocked.

Because this is specific to a newly invited user and you’re seeing an “access denied” message after she accepts the invite (while other users can log in), we’ll need a support engineer to review the invitation/access status for that user.

To help us get to this quickly today, please reply with:
1) The workspace name and the URL (or app name) she’s trying to access
2) The exact “access denied” text (copy/paste) and where she sees it (which page/app/step)
3) The new analyst’s email (or username) and the role you assigned in the invite
4) Approx. time she accepted the invite (and timezone)
5) Confirm whether she can log in to the platform overall, but not the workspace (or if she can’t log in at all)

Once we have the above, we’ll escalate internally for human troubleshooting of the invite/workspace permissions and let you know the outcome as soon as possible.
promised_actions: Escalate to a support engineer for human troubleshooting of the invitation/workspace access issue.
Follow up after reviewing the invitation/access details provided.
safety_notes: Avoid promising a resolution “today” without confirming internal review outcome.
Do not state root cause or specific fix; request minimum missing details for accurate troubleshooting.

parsed.customer_impact: The new analyst cannot access the workspace, blocking their ability to use the system as intended, and the ticket is marked urgent to resolve today.
grounded_facts: A new analyst was invited yesterday.
After the analyst accepted the invite, she receives an 'access denied' message.
Other users are able to log in normally.
The request is to get the new analyst into the workspace today.
missing_information: Which workspace/application the analyst is trying to access (name/URL).

risk_signals: Account/workspace access failure for a newly invited user (could indicate misconfiguration or permission/role assignment issues).
